title: Peruvian-Style Fish Ceviche
description: A refreshing and zesty ceviche dish originating from Peru, made with fresh fish marinated in citrus juices and mixed with vibrant Peruvian-inspired flavors.

ingredients.name: Silky Peruvian aji panca oil (or regular olive oil)

instructions: Cut the fish into small pieces and place in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the lime juice, lemon juice, aji amarillo peppers, red onion, cilantro, and salt.
Pour the marinade over the fish and toss to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving, stir in the Peruvian corn kernels, fish bouillon (if using), and aji panca oil.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the ceviche immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
